query:
UPDATE agent_sessions
        SET
            status = 'idle',
            user_id = $2,
            agent_type = $3,
            model = $4,
            mode = $5,
            updated_at = NOW(),
            last_heartbeat = NOW(),
            completed_at = NULL,
            error_message = NULL,
            current_task = NULL
        WHERE chat_id = $1
